== Dan Sokol added to Members (27 October 2026) ==
[[Dan Sokol]] is listed as a member on Bill Bisco's ruling (27 October 2026). The basis is the yellow Team Albany shirt he wears in Decipher's DecipherCon 1999 photo thu16 ([[:File:Team Albany DecipherCon 1999.jpg]]), plus [[Matt Sokol]]'s identification of him in that photo (personal communication to Bill Bisco, 27 October 2026). No published roster names him. Also: the photo paragraph now names all five people, and the thu16 ref now uses the live URL with the same Preserved copies as the File page. "Dan Sokol missed the convention" now says [[DecipherCon 2000]], the event Sokol's DeckTech report covers.
